high_level_description: This image depicts a modern living room with a minimalist design. The room features a large framed abstract painting on the wall, which is the focal point of the space. The painting has a predominantly blue color scheme with hints of green and white, giving it a serene and calming effect. The room includes a dark green sofa with a simple, sleek design, positioned against the wall. In front of the sofa, there is a low, wooden coffee table with a few decorative items on it, including what appears to be a small vase or container holding some greenery.
